Pantip, Webtretho, Facebook, LINE, X and Reddit searches in-language ran dry of fresh (<=14d) Gucci-specific SEA items today.

items.title: Mariah Carey Checks In for Christmas in Gucci's 2026 Holiday Campaign
items.summary: WWD covers Gucci's new 2026 holiday campaign film directed by Harmony Korine, starring Mariah Carey in a hotel transformed for the holidays, set to her song 'All I Want for Christmas Is You.' Carey models pieces from the new Butterfly capsule tied to her 1997 album. Global activation relevant to SEA as regional lifestyle press and SNS are already syndicating the holiday push.

items.title: Gucci Sets Up New Business Units' Organization
items.summary: Gucci is restructuring into business units, bringing in industry veterans Monica Ulmi and Marco Semeghini as senior advisers based between Milan and Florence, working alongside Demna and CEO Francesca Bellettini. The memo frames the change as improving focus and faster decision-making amid the brand's ongoing turnaround effort, relevant to how APAC/SEA retail execution gets managed going forward.

items.title: Kering slides as Gucci sales fall 6% despite in-line Q3 revenue
items.summary: Reuters-sourced wire report on Kering's Q3 2026 results: Gucci comparable sales fell 6%, directly operated retail sales down 9% with lower traffic weighing particularly on Asia Pacific including mainland China and Japan; Kering shares slumped roughly 12% on the news. Negative earnings/momentum signal with direct APAC relevance since SEA sits in the same regional demand pool as the cited China/Japan traffic softness; tagged negative_earnings per rubric given the sustained-decline framing ('slides', 'deepens').

items.title: Cara Membedakan Tas Branded KW dengan yang Asli (How to spot fake branded bags)
items.summary: Indonesian Kaskus community thread on distinguishing counterfeit from authentic designer bags names Gucci among the brands most frequently counterfeited and traded in the grey market alongside LV, Chanel and Prada. Neutral-to-mild-negative per rubric's counterfeit-inquiry category; signals ongoing counterfeit-market pressure on the brand in Indonesia.

items.title: Gucci yang Available in Malaysia
items.summary: Malaysian Lowyat Forum thread discussing which Gucci product lines and store locations (KLCC, Pavilion, The Exchange TRX) are available in Malaysia, with posters comparing RM pricing against Louis Vuitton, Prada and Fendi. Largely neutral informational/shopping-advice content with occasional value-for-money grumbling about price gaps versus overseas boutiques.

items.title: Mariah Carey Leads Gucci's 2026 Holiday Campaign Amid Mixed Reactions
items.summary: Aggregated public Instagram comment reactions to Gucci's Mariah Carey holiday campaign film are split: some praise Carey's presence ('earned this level of respect'), others call the Harmony Korine-directed film 'sterile, cold, and devoid of humanity' or liken it to a horror vignette, and one commenter says Gucci 'gave up' aesthetically with its monogram prints. Genuine organic SNS reaction to a brand activation (not brand-sourced), carrying independent evaluative judgment on both sides; coded mixed/negative-leaning under the dominant-thesis rule given the weight of critical comments surfaced.

items.title: Is Gucci Good Again? 2026 Reset: La Famiglia RTW & New Glow Blushes Review
items.summary: Independent fashion/beauty YouTube reviewer asks whether Demna's Gucci reset is working, reviewing the La Famiglia ready-to-wear line and new Gucci Beauty Glow blushes with a skeptical-but-open verdict. Independent third-party judgment, not brand-sourced, so not capped by the activation discount; relevant to SEA audiences given Gucci Beauty's regional retail push (e.g., the concurrent SOGO Malaysia festive promo).

items.title: Gucci Unboxing GONE WRONG!
items.summary: Consumer unboxing video documents visible quality/damage issues with a Gucci bag on arrival. Organic negative product-quality signal from an individual creator; small-channel reach, included under the rubric's quality-complaint category.

items.title: Now Till 15 November 2026: SOGO Malaysia: Gucci Beauty Festive Promotion
items.summary: Local Malaysian retail-deals site reports a running Gucci Beauty gift-with-purchase promotion (free pouch and miniature with RM350 minimum spend) at SOGO Kuala Lumpur and Johor Bahru through Nov 15, 2026. Purely descriptive promotional listing, scored neutral per the activation-coverage rule; included for Buzz-channel volume in the Malaysian retail market.

items.title: Gucci Thu Đông 2026 tôn vinh Femme Fatale của điện ảnh
items.summary: Vietnamese edition of Harper's Bazaar covers Gucci Fall/Winter 2026 (Demna's debut runway collection) through a cinematic femme-fatale styling lens, noting Vietnamese-market ambassador activity (Hồ Ngọc Hà's Milan attendance) and the collection's logo-simplification direction. Descriptive activation coverage with mild editorial praise for the aesthetic direction; magnitude capped per the activation discount.

items.title: Why luxury brands are increasingly turning to Southeast Asia for growth
items.summary: Trade/retail analysis names Gucci among LVMH, Dior and Hermes houses expanding store footprints across Bangkok malls, Singapore's prime shopping districts and Vietnam's growing mono-brand network, framing SEA as a structural growth hedge against China softness. Neutral/positive industry-context piece, useful for the region's overall market-attractiveness read rather than brand-specific sentiment.
